title: Charged wood tank zeroes 4 of 5 space-only multi-start seeds; mild two-zone days ship the all-off plan
claim: On a two-tank (wood) two-zone house without DHW, HeatPumpOptimizer's space-only solve hands _multi_start_minimize 4 all-zero starts of 5 in 32 of the 60 cells of this seat's axis, and on the 5 mild 24 h cells it ships a 0 kWh plan that a one-run challenger beats by 1.47-2.03 objective units with no feasibility loss.
mechanism: optimizer.py (space-only path, ~line 5507): seed_power = baseline_power * (1 - _wood_covered_share(...)); a tank that covers the thermostat reference gives share 1.0, so seed_power, baseline_energy and the three _price_ranked_start vectors built from baseline_energy (full, low, deep-low) are all zero. Only the price-weighted initial guess is live, and the all-off point is a stationary basin for the relaxed descent (the start term is not in the relaxed objective, and a run below the 1 kW floor is clipped by the candidate stage), so the multi-start has no start inside the one-run basin the true objective prefers.

evidence.unit: objective units (J_prod - J_best, max over the 5 gap cells; census: 32 of 60 cells with 4/5 zero starts)
evidence.contention_note: counts and objective values; contention-immune (D0-s2 M6 loops and D3/D9 seats running)

perturbation.change: WOOD_SHARE_OFF=1: optimizer._wood_covered_share patched to return 0.0 (seed from the reference unscaled)
perturbation.observed_value: gap_abs 2.029/1.678/1.631/1.468 -> 0.000 on the four summer_cool cells, 1.725 -> 0.577 on winter_typical/shoulder; census all-but-one-zero cells 32 -> 4, zero starts 128 -> 16 (the 4 left are summer_warm/6h, which needs no heat)

metric_definition: gap_abs = J_prod - J_best feasible challenger (race.py arms seeds/warm, production objective); zero_starts = all-zero candidates in the space-only multi-start call
phenomenon_property: The space-only multi-start's structured starts must not collapse to the all-zero vector because a free heat source covers the thermostat reference: at least one start besides the price-weighted guess carries energy whenever the shipped horizon can need heat.

null_control.note: Survives flat prices: the gap is not price optimality but solver structure (seed collapse); named so per D0.M5. Bills on these days are ~0 SEK of energy: the gap is the objective's comfort-pull term (challenger buys 3.0-5.1 kWh).

reproduction_steps: run the --race command with and without WOOD_SHARE_OFF=1
proposed_fix_scope: optimizer.py space-only seeding: keep the wood-scaled seed and add an unscaled (or floor-level single-run) start, so a covered reference cannot empty the seed set; the DHW path (_solve_space) does not scale and is untouched.
